neighbours.label: Admiring commentary on how a handmade or decorative object was made (the effort, skill or method behind it: 'took hours', 'must have been made', 'what font did you use'), vs plain description of the same object
fire: The little clay animals on her shelf are so detailed, and obviously took weeks of careful sculpting.
Those carved wooden birds must have taken someone a whole winter to finish.
I love the lettering on your shop sign. What brush did you use for it?
The quilt was stitched entirely by hand, which shows real patience and skill.
Such fine lace could only have been made by an experienced needleworker.
Her paper lanterns look store-bought, but she actually folded every one herself.
The tiny gingerbread village clearly took the baker days to assemble.
What glaze did you use on these mugs? The colour is gorgeous.
quiet: The little clay animals on her shelf are painted brown and stand in a row.
Those carved wooden birds hang above the kitchen window in her cottage.
The lettering on the shop sign is blue on a white background.
The quilt lies folded at the foot of the guest bed upstairs.
The fine lace curtains were taken down for washing on Saturday.
Her paper lanterns hang along the porch during the summer festival.
The tiny gingerbread village sits in the bakery window every December.
These mugs are kept on the top shelf next to the teapot.

predictions: Remarks on the making, effort or skill behind a crafted or visual object 0.3-0.8; the same objects described by colour, size or place under 0.1.
